claude_proposed_widenings.name: SwapPreparedSpellEffect (ClassFeatureEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Memorize Spell's effect is mutating the prepared-spell list: one prepared level-1+ Wizard spell is removed and another level-1+ spell from the spellbook is added in its place. Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect can represent this. The v4 taxonomy lists grant_spell_access as an effect atom, but ClassFeatureEffect in types.ts exposes no variant for prepared-list mutation. A new variant is needed — e.g. { kind: 'swap_prepared_spell'; minSpellLevel: number; source: 'spellbook' } or a broader modify_prepared_spells shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared for your Spellcasting feature with another level 1+ spell from the book

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestTriggeredActivation or optional resource in ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader mandates resource: UseCountResource + resetCadence. Memorize Spell imposes no explicit use count — the SRD text says 'Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can...' without a stated limit. The trigger is the short rest itself. Modeling it as fixed:1/short_rest is a pragmatic approximation but misrepresents the SRD. A variant where the rest completion is the trigger rather than the reset cadence of a use-count resource would model this family more honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace...
